grand_totals_with_kpi_ratios.purpose: Summarize the main like-for-like trading result and the core basket and pricing KPIs in one-row outputs for the four comparable branches.
grand_totals_with_kpi_ratios.query:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %]
    ),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
)

comparable_monthly_trend.purpose: Show how like-for-like revenue, quantity and bills have moved over the available months, with the most recent dates first.
comparable_monthly_trend.query:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "net bills PAST", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %]
        ),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    ),
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date], DESC
)

category_risk_summary.purpose: Measure breadth of category decline and the sales weight of those declining categories, which are both needed for category health reporting.
category_risk_summary.query:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE (
    ROW (
        "COUNT", [COUNT],
        "COUNT_TOTAL", [COUNT_TOTAL],
        "COUNT_PLUS", [COUNT_PLUS],
        "COUNT %", [COUNT %]
    ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
    TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] )
)

store_by_special_product_group_cross.purpose: Highlight the largest store-by-category combinations shaping the result, so branch commentary can point to specific commercial pockets.
store_by_special_product_group_cross.query:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no],
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name],
            TREATAS( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
            TREATAS( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
            TREATAS( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
            TREATAS( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] ),
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "prior bills", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth]
        ),
        "SortAbsRevenueGrowth", ABS([revenue Growth])
    ),
    [SortAbsRevenueGrowth], DESC
)
